```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(ROCR)
library(caret)
```

Loading file
```{r}
gene_exp <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/gene_exp.RData")
pt_status <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_status.RData")
pt_char <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_char.RData")

met_outcomes <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_outcomes.RData")
met_data <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_data.RData")
met_char <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_char.RData")

```
Splitting by cohort and outcome

```{r}
source("../rf_functions.R")
```


#Creating objects for runs
```{r}
#joining nanostring and outcomes for both adjuvant and metastatic
crossover_outcomes <- full_join(pt_status, met_outcomes)
crossover_data <- full_join(gene_exp, met_data)
adjtrain_rec_list <- c("VTCN1", "CD276", "CD8A")
mettrain_pro_list <- c("PTPRC_3")
#Unshuffled 
seed_list <- c(12345:12369)
#Shuffled
run_number <- 1:1000
seed_list_r <- c(12345:13344)


adj_null <- full_join(gene_exp, pt_char)
met_null <- full_join(met_data, met_char)
nullmodel <- full_join(adj_null, met_null) %>%
  select(-`Platelets (K/uL)`)
#no platelets in met data
null_list <- colnames(nullmodel)[2:length(nullmodel)]

```


#Adj rec train meta pro test
```{r}
#running predictive model
rf_rec_adjtrain <- kTest(seed_list,
                     "Therapy complete",
                     "Progression",
                     "Model",
                     crossover_outcomes,
                     crossover_data,
                     "Adj_Exp",
                     "Met_Val",
                     adjtrain_rec_list) 


saveRDS(rf_rec_adjtrain, file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_adjtrain.RData")

rf_rec_adjtrain_random <- shuffled_rf(seed_list,
                                        "Therapy complete",
                                        "Progression",
                                        crossover_outcomes,
                                        nullmodel,
                                        "Adj_Exp",
                                        "Met_Val",
                                        null_list
)





saveRDS(rf_rec_adjtrain_random, file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_adjtrain_random.RData")


rec.adjtrain <- met.p.calc(rf_rec_adjtrain_random,
                        "Progression",
                       rf_rec_adjtrain)


```


#Meta train pro Adj test rec
```{r}
#running predictive model
rf_pro_metatrain <- kTest(seed_list,
                     "Therapy complete",
                     "Progression",
                     "Model",
                     crossover_outcomes,
                     crossover_data,
                     "Met_Exp",
                     "Adj_Val",
                     mettrain_pro_list) 


saveRDS(rf_pro_metatrain, file = "../Outputs/rf_pro_metatrain.RData")

rf_pro_metatrain_random <- shuffled_rf(seed_list,
                                        "Therapy complete",
                                        "Progression",
                                        crossover_outcomes,
                                        nullmodel,
                                        "Met_Exp",
                                        "Adj_Val",
                                        null_list
)



saveRDS(rf_pro_metatrain_random, file = "../Outputs/rf_pro_metatrain_random.RData")


pro_metatrain <- met.p.calc(rf_pro_metatrain_random,
                        "Progression",
                       rf_pro_metatrain)


```







#loading files
```{r}

rf_rec_adjtrain_random <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_adjtrain_random.RData")
rf_rec_adjtrain <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_rec_adjtrain.RData")

rf_pro_metatrain_random <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_pro_metatrain_random.RData")

```

f1.graph.cross(rf_rec_adjtrain_random,
